text:
customer_jordan: Hey team — during a streaming completion the client cut out mid-response when switching from office WiFi to cellular. Output stopped at ~60% and the client never resumed. Happened twice today around 10:23am PST. App: iOS 16.5, app v1.4.3, SDK: redwood-js 0.9.2. Request id I have from client: x-rd-request-id=rd_5f8a7c. Any ideas?

maria_support: Sorry you're hitting this — can you paste the raw client logs and the last lines from the server logs if available? Also which endpoint exactly (e.g. /v1/streams or /v1/chat/streaming)?

customer_jordan: Using /v1/streams/generate. Client log snippet: ```
[10:23:12.412] SSE: connected
[10:23:55.801] recv 0 bytes (EOF)
[10:23:55.802] socket closed: ECONNRESET
[10:23:55.812] reconnect attempt 1
[10:23:55.900] reconnect failed: timeout
```

ben_infra: That looks like an immediate TCP-level reset rather than a graceful close. Do you have any proxies between client and api.redwood.com (corp proxy, carrier NAT, or local edge)? Cellular handoffs often trigger NAT rebinding and cause the 4-tuple to break.

lee_mobile: On iOS the OS will tear background sockets when network changes. App should attempt a reconnect and ideally send a Last-Event-ID or a resume token. Do you implement last-event-id semantics, or rely on SDK autoResume?

customer_jordan: We rely on SDK autoResume currently, we haven't implemented last-event-id.

maria_support: FYI SDK 0.9.2 has best-effort autoResume but it can't recover the in-flight KV cache for streaming prefs; if the socket is torn at TCP layer the upstream sees it as a hard reset. Can you try reproducing with curl on the device to isolate app vs network? Example: 
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \\n  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \\n  "https://api.redwood.com/v1/streams/generate?model=gpt-mini"
```
(use `-N` to disable curl buffering).

ben_infra: I pulled server-side logs for rd_5f8a7c — edge logged `502 upstream prematurely closed connection` at 2026-03-16T17:23:55Z and we see a correlated RTT spike (from ~40ms to ~420ms) right before the reset. That pattern (RTT spike -> proxy reset) points at our edge layer closing idle or stalled connections when backend latency climbs.

sre-bot: Alert: EDGE_CONN_RESET spike detected in us-west-2 at 2026-03-16T17:23Z. Count: 32 resets/minute.

maria_support: Short-term mitigation: enable frequent streaming heartbeats from the server or client to prevent `proxy_read_timeout` from triggering. Server-side we can send SSE comment heartbeats like `: \n` every 10-15s. On the client, ensure the SDK or app sends/accepts heartbeats.

lee_mobile: On iOS, also set `URLSessionConfiguration.httpMaximumConnectionsPerHost` and ensure `tcpKeepAlive` isn't being dropped by background policies. If you can't change app behavior immediately, implement app-side quick reconnect with resume token.

customer_jordan: Is this a billing concern? We saw a charge even though the response truncated.

maria_support: Partial outputs are billed up to the last successfully delivered token. We'll open a billing review but that's expected behavior currently — we can loop in billing if you believe the charge is incorrect.

ben_infra: For us to dig deeper we need a pcap from the client during repro and the full x-rd-request-id header value. Can you run this on a reproducer device while you flip WiFi->cell: `sudo tcpdump -i any -w rd_repro.pcap host api.redwood.com and port 443` and attach the file. Also collect the app console log and the SDK debug dump.

customer_jordan: Ok I'll try to repro with curl and collect a pcap and logs. Quick question — is there any gateway config you can change on your side now?

maria_support: We can adjust proxy timeouts for a short window and test, but changing global timeouts is a coordinated SRE change. I'll open an internal ticket and request a localized test tweak for your customer id. Ticket created: TICKET-8923.

ben_infra: Also try adding an app-level keepalive: send a single newline every 10s from the server or client. That tends to keep NAT mappings and proxies happier. If you can add `Last-Event-ID` semantics that's the most robust resume path.

customer_jordan: Got it — will add heartbeat and try the repro. Thanks for the quick responses :thumbsup:

maria_support: Thanks — please upload the pcap + logs to the ticket and ping here when done. We'll triage with SRE and loop in billing if needed.
